name: solve-workspace
description: Workspace root for the Solve expression-evaluation engine, its playground bridge, and the interactive playground.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/engine && npm run build --workspace=packages/cli && npm run build --workspace=packages/mcp
scripts.setup: npm run build && npm ci --prefix docs && npm ci --prefix playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/mcp
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:bundled && npm run smoke:globals && npm run smoke:cli && npm run smoke:mcp
scripts.verify:ci: npm run lint && npm run lint:comments && npm run lint:messages && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:actions && npm run lint:action-inputs && npm run lint:licenses && npm run audit:deps && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test:full && npm run test:temporal && npm run lint:stats && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:bundled && npm run smoke:globals && npm run smoke:cli && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run lint:package && npm run lint:size && npm run lint:units && npm run lint:keywords && npm run lint:sidebar && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:cheatsheet && npm run lint:error-codes && npm run lint:jest-configs && npm run lint:ci-parity && npm run lint:dispatch-size && npm run test:consumer
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/engine/src packages/engine/__tests__ packages/engine/tools packages/playground-bridge/src packages/cli/src packages/mcp/src scripts
scripts.lint:package: npx --yes publint@0.3.23 packages/engine && npx --yes @arethetypeswrong/cli@0.18.5 --pack packages/engine --ignore-rules no-resolution
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run build --prefix playground
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run build && npm run test:full && npm run stats:tests && npm run stats:units && npm run stats:size

author: Liam Riddell
